trailhead.label: Rifugio Gilberti, at the top of the Canin cable car from Sella Nevea, the board’s start

cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
Rocky karst ground with large boulders: watch your dog’s paws on sharp limestone.
High and open at 1,800–2,000 m: storms build fast and snow can lie into early summer.
The Canin cable car takes dogs only on a lead and muzzled, one per cabin, with a ticket.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
